correctness.rationale: All even n>=6 simple cycle matchings into unordered pairs are considered with utility 1 precisely for neighboring partners. Direct exchange analysis shows stability iff bad/unhappy vertices are independent and no existing bad pair closes a 3-edge path with its middle edge a good pair. The other vertices pair consecutively inside gaps, forcing odd cyclic gap lengths >=3, and endpoints of gap 3 may not partner. For even u>=4, inclusion-exclusion over size-j matchings of the compressed u-cycle yields the claimed summand with u/(u-j) C(u-j,j)(u-2j-1)!! C(s+u-j-1,u-j-1) and n/u root correction; u=2 counted separately and u=0 gives two matchings. Gap bound 3u<=n and opposite-index constructions give u_max and price n/(n-u_max), including exceptions n6,8 and n10. Independent direct enumeration of all pair partitions for n=6,8,10,12 confirms counts 2;2;(2,5);(2,12,3); finite data are not proof.
